text: That confirms a neuromuscular junction issue like Myasthenia Gravis. Given your difficulty climbing stairs and upper limb weakness, are your symptoms worse later in the day or after exertion, and have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids (ptosis)?

text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.
